label: Meta AI (WhatsApp Web)
login_hint: Switch to the browser workspace (default 8) and scan the QR code with your phone (WhatsApp → Settings → Linked devices). The profile keeps the session; you only do this once.

start.open_selector: [aria-label="Meta AI" i], [data-icon="ai-heart-blue"], div[aria-label="Meta AI chat" i]

consent_js: () => { const names = ['got it', 'ok, got it', 'accept', 'continue', 'update', 'later', 'not now', 'zrozumiano', 'zaakceptuj', 'kontynuuj', 'później', 'nie teraz']; const btns = [...document.querySelectorAll('button, div[role="button"]')]; for (const name of names) { const b = btns.find(x => (x.innerText || x.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').trim().toLowerCase() === name); if (b) { b.click(); return name; } } return null; }
state_js: () => { const msgs = document.querySelectorAll('div[data-id]'); if (!msgs.length) return { ready: false }; let last = null; for (const m of msgs) { if (m.querySelector('.message-out')) continue; if (m.innerText && m.innerText.trim()) last = m; } if (!last) return { ready: false }; const t = last.innerText.trim(); const done = !!last.querySelector('[data-status="read"], [data-icon="check-check"], [data-icon="double-check"], span[data-icon="tick"]'); return { ready: true, text: t, complete: done || t.length > 0 }; }
pane_text_js: () => { const el = document.querySelector('div[data-id=""] + div, footer'); const main = document.querySelector('#main'); return main ? main.innerText : ''; }
extract_js: () => { const msgs = document.querySelectorAll('div[data-id]'); const out = { answer: '', sources: [], turns: 0 }; if (!msgs.length) return out; let last = null; for (const m of msgs) { if (m.querySelector('.message-out')) { out.turns++; continue; } if (m.innerText && m.innerText.trim()) last = m; } if (!last) return out; out.answer = last.innerText.trim(); last.querySelectorAll('a[href^="http"]').forEach(a => { const href = a.getAttribute('href'); if (href && !out.sources.some(s => s.href === href)) out.sources.push({ site: '', title: a.innerText.trim(), snippet: '', href }); }); return out; }
